summary: Lincoln County, MT tower site: 40-foot pole observation tower with log cabin recorded for 1914, abandoned 1935, now listed as gone; no source describes it today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole observation tower with log cabin (1914); log cabin on north point (1929)
facts.status_note: Abandoned 1935 per firelookout.com; Forest Fire Lookout Association list codes it Tower Gone; no source describes what remains
facts.agency: Kootenai National Forest (land unit per county list)

events.note: Record for 1914 lists a 40-foot pole observation tower and log cabin; the record gives no construction date
Record lists a log cabin on the north point for 1929

evidence.supports: 1914 record: 40-foot pole observation tower with log cabin
1929 record: log cabin on the north point
patrol point 4 miles west, atop South Fork
evidence.quote: Patrol 4 miles west atop South Fork.

evidence.supports: patrol point 2 miles southwest, atop Garden Ridge
evidence.quote: Patrol 2 miles southwest atop Garden Ridge.

evidence.supports: association list codes the site as a tower that is gone
county list places the site in the Kootenai National Forest
association list gives latitude 48.66797 and longitude -115.41373

notes_for_editor: All of the history comes from one page (firelookout.com). The 1914 entry records what stood that year and does not give a construction date, so the built event carries that caveat. The association and county lists confirm the gone status and the forest only. Two searches found no newspaper, agency or photo account of the site. The height is converted from the source's 40 feet. Access and today's condition are unknown; no visitor report was found.
